freeze_policy: Final presentation snapshot. No automatic refresh; apply documented corrections only unless Sean explicitly requests a new snapshot.

post_archive.download_scope: Only the 11.3 MB compressed posts JSONL; no media objects or other archives.

selection: Country Iran, conflict_new_id 16905; event-specific documented U.S./joint attribution, including the explicitly marked rescue-operation-context exception. Prior included IDs are reconciled to the current release; withdrawn IDs are not carried forward. Generic report titles alone are not event-specific attribution.
post_selection: Preserve legacy reviewed IDs; additionally include original nonempty 2026 posts matching Iran/Iranian, Tehran, Hormuz, or Khamenei, applied uniformly across all dates. Match date windows using America/New_York calendar dates. Media content is not inferred.

model.name: facebook/bart-large-mnli

frame_prompts.Threat: military threats, escalation, retaliation, ultimatums, warnings, strikes, or destruction directed at Iran
frame_prompts.Victory: claims of victory, military success, Iranian weakness, defeat, surrender, decimation, or successful U.S. operations
frame_prompts.Diplomacy: diplomacy, negotiations, talks, deals, conditions, agreements, or communication with Iran or allied governments
frame_prompts.Ceasefire / Ending: a ceasefire, stopping military operations, ending the conflict, pausing attacks, or declaring the fighting essentially finished
frame_prompts.Blame Allies: blaming or criticizing NATO, European allies, or other countries for not helping enough or being unhelpful
frame_prompts.Media Criticism: criticizing, blaming, or attacking the mainstream news media, journalists, or press coverage as biased, fake, or dishonest

model.legacy_scores: 90 scores reused only when normalized source text matched; original model revision was not pinned.

counts.post_selection: Preserve legacy reviewed IDs; additionally include original nonempty 2026 posts matching Iran/Iranian, Tehran, Hormuz, or Khamenei, applied uniformly across all dates. Match date windows using America/New_York calendar dates. Media content is not inferred.

quality_limits: Model accuracy remains unvalidated by human labels.
Headline-based U.S. involvement is a project review, not an official UCDP actor variable. Generic war titles are insufficient.
Multi-day starts are not precise dates for each death; no intraday ordering is inferred.
Source record 625182 has inconsistent death bounds; retained as supplied and excluded from same-day severity.
Legacy source/model inference is not fully pinned; newly scored texts use a pinned model revision.
file_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with universal newlines normalized to LF; official source receipts use exact downloaded bytes.

derived_threat_timeline.aggregation: Equal post weights in non-overlapping 14-day periods anchored 2026-02-28; source cutoff unchanged.
